title: Aerosoft A340-600 WinCtrl Throttle Setup - Control All 4 Engines
description:
Is your WinWing URSA MINOR 32 Throttle not working with the Aerosoft A340-600 in MSFS 2024? If you are struggling to map 4 engines to your 2 levers or your detents aren't aligning properly, you aren't alone. In this quick guide, I show you exactly how to fix the "4-engine mapping" issue and calibrate your throttle for the newly released Aerosoft A340-600.

We dive deep into the essential profile duplication and axis settings that most pilots miss. Setting this correctly ensures a linear axis that Microsoft Flight Simulator can actually understand, preventing those frustrating throttle spikes or reversed flaps during departure.

In this video, we cover:

EFB Joystick Settings: Why you MUST turn off when using it with the WinCTRL throttle
MSFS 2024 Axis Mapping: Setting up Engine 1-2 and 3-4 on a dual-lever throttle.
A340 Detent Calibration: How to use the Aerosoft tablet to sync your physical detents (CL, MCT, TOGA).
Troubleshooting: Fixing the inverted flap axis and saving your calibration values correctly.

Stop fighting your hardware and start enjoying the realism of the URSA MINOR 32 Throttle Metal. I’ve even included my personal MSFS 2024 control profile below to save you the hassle of manual mapping!
